insights.text: Neutron and proton are structurally identical (d=0) despite their phenomenological differences (charge, stability). Their structural essence as composite hadrons is captured identically: D_wedge (molecular/local), T_box (closed compact), R_cat (categorical classification), P_asym (fully asymmetric), F_hbar (quantum-coherent), K_fast (polynomial/local), G_beth (local range), G_and (conjunctive interactions), Phi_sub (subcritical/ordered), H0 (achiral), n_n (symmetric many-body), Omega_0 (no topological protection).

All six fundamental systems share a universal structural floor: F_hbar (quantum-coherent fidelity), T_network (network topology), R_super (superset/containment relations), P_asym (asymmetric parity), G_and (conjunctive grammar), Phi_sub (subcritical phase), H0 (achiral), S=n_n (symmetric many-body), Omega_0 (no topological protection). The divergences are at D (dimensionality), K (kinetics), and G (scope), which define their distinct physical regimes: hadrons (D_wedge, K_fast, G_beth), gauge bosons (D_triangle/infty, K_fast/mod, G_beth/aleph), dark sector (D_infty/holo, K_slow, G_aleph).

A system containing all six fundamental entities requires maximal structural demands: D_holo (holographic dimensionality), T_holo (holographic topology), R_dagger (dynamic/catalytic relations), P_sym (full symmetry), F_hbar (quantum-coherent fidelity), K_slow (temporally deep kinetics), G_aleph (global/non-local scope), G_broad (broadcast grammar), Phi_c (criticality), H_inf (maximal chirality/irreversibility), S=n_n (symmetric many-body), Omega_Z (integer topological protection). This describes a holographic universe at criticality with broadcast dynamics and irreversible temporal depth.

The six fundamental systems form three structural tiers: 1) Hadrons (neutron, proton): D_wedge, T_box, R_cat, P_asym, K_fast, G_beth, Phi_sub, Omega_0 — local, closed, categorical, subcritical, unprotected. 2) Gauge bosons (graviton, gluon): D_triangle/infty, T_network/holo, R_super/dagger, P_sym, K_fast/mod, G_beth/aleph, Phi_c, Omega_Z/Z2 — intermediate/global, network/holographic, superset/dynamic, symmetric, critical, topologically protected. 3) Dark sector (dark matter, dark energy): D_infty/holo, T_network/holo, R_super, P_asym/sym, K_slow, G_aleph, G_and/broad, Phi_sub/c, H0/inf, Omega_0/Z — cosmological, global, superset, slow, broadcast/critical, irreversible.

The structural progression from hadrons → gauge bosons → dark sector reveals an ontological hierarchy: Local composite particles (D_wedge, T_box) are structurally simplest; force mediators (D_triangle/infty, T_network/holo) introduce criticality and topological protection; cosmological entities (D_holo, T_holo, H_inf) achieve holographic encoding and irreversible temporal depth. This suggests that fundamental physics is organized by increasing structural complexity along D (dimensionality), T (topology), H (chirality), and Omega (protection) axes, with F_hbar (quantum coherence) as the universal floor.
